rows.definition: The informal noun kvcost.go's doc comments and the docs corpus use for whichever eviction mechanism is currently making a keep/drop decision (radixkv's LRU pass, the kvmmu coldest-by-EMA policy, or #2239's cost-aware picker) - a role description, not one Go symbol.
rows.distinction: It names the AGENT performing eviction generically in prose and is never itself grounded to one callable - PickEvictionVictim is the concrete cost-aware picker, and KVSpanEvictor is the concrete Go interface for the model-side quarantine bridge; this row is neither.

rows.definition: radixkv.(*Tree).evictToBudget is the unexported method that repeatedly picks a victim leaf (LRU by default, or cost-aware under policy EvictionCostAware) and removes it via removeLeaf until the tree's cached token count is back within maxTokens.
rows.distinction: It is the RUNTIME eviction LOOP that actually mutates the radix prefix-cache tree under a token budget, NOT EvictUnderBudget's kvmmu Context/CapabilityLedger budget-gated eviction, and NOT KVEvictLRU/KVEvictCostAware, which are the offline replay-benchmark POLICY LABELS ReplayKVCache simulates rather than a live tree mutation.

rows.definition: compute.KVEvictCostAware is the KVEvictPolicy enum constant selecting #2239's value-aware victim ranking (cheapest-to-lose per KVEvictionCost, LRU tie-break) inside ReplayKVCache and the kvbm benchmark harness.
rows.distinction: It is a POLICY-SELECTOR value passed to ReplayKVCache/ReplayKVTrace to choose which cost function the simulator runs, NOT KVEvictionCost itself (the scoring function it selects) and NOT PickEvictionVictim (the production victim-choice call, which always scores by base KVEvictionCost rather than taking a policy argument).

rows.definition: compute.KVEvictionCost(s) is #2239's base per-span value-of-keeping formula (Tokens * (Hits+1) / Bytes, +Inf fail-open on non-positive Bytes) - a higher score means more expensive to lose per byte, so the cheapest-to-lose (lowest-score) span is the eviction victim.
rows.distinction: It is the BASE scoring function using only Tokens/Hits/Bytes, NOT KVEvictionCostAged (which adds the frozen AgeStamp aging term) or KVEvictionCostPinned (which additionally folds in TTL-decaying PinBoost/Hint economics) - both variants are strict extensions that reduce to this function on their zero-value inputs.

rows.definition: compute.KVEvictionCostAged(s) in kvcost_aging.go returns s.AgeStamp + KVEvictionCost(s), the GDSF-style aging term that lets recency re-enter the cost ranking (not just break ties) via the pool-stamped AgingClock value frozen on the span's last reference.
rows.distinction: It is KVEvictionCost PLUS an additive aging-clock term (an all-zero-stamp resident set reduces byte-identically to the base score), distinct from KVEvictionCostPinned's additive PinBoost/Hint economics and from PickEvictionVictimAged (the victim-selection wrapper that scores with this function, not the function itself).

rows.definition: compute.KVEvictionCostPinned(s) in kvcost_pin.go extends KVEvictionCost with #2673's TTL-decaying PinBoost term and the #2225 Hint (precious/ephemeral) bounded multiplier, folding pin economics into the cost-of-losing additively rather than a hard bypass, and reduces exactly to KVEvictionCost when PinBoost==0 and Hint==HintNone.
rows.distinction: It is the PIN/HINT-aware score, distinct from KVEvictionCostAged's aging-clock extension and from the absolute Pinned bool hard-exclusion pickLowestCost already applies (PinBoost is documented as that hard exclusion's +Inf limit, not a replacement for it).

rows.definition: compute.KVEvictLRU is the KVEvictPolicy enum zero-value selecting pure recency-only eviction inside ReplayKVCache/kvbm - the baseline #2239's cost-aware mode must beat on a trace with hot/cold structure.
rows.distinction: It is an offline REPLAY-BENCHMARK policy label compared against KVEvictCostAware inside the simulator, NOT radixkv's live evictToBudget LRU pass (the actual production mutation it models) and not a scoring function itself.

rows.definition: agent.KVSpanEvictor is the Go interface (EvictKVSpan) InKernelPlanner implements to bridge a tool-result QUARANTINE (#579) into the kvmmu governance layer: it rebuilds the transcript as labeled per-message K/V segments on a fresh model.Session and evicts the poisoned segment via the proven model.KVCache.Evict, engaged only when FAK_INKERNEL_KVMMU opts in.
rows.distinction: It is the kvmmu-BRIDGE half of quarantine eviction (fresh-session segment rebuild + re-RoPE), distinct from its sibling agent.PoisonEvictor (which drops a reusable radixkv PREFIX node instead) and from the generic informal 'evictor' role term - the gateway type-asserts a planner to both interfaces independently and either can be absent.

rows.definition: compute.PickEvictionVictim(spans) returns the index of the cheapest-to-lose evictable span per KVEvictionCost (skipping Pinned/Leased spans, LRU tie-break, -1 when nothing is evictable) - the function #2239 names as the eventual replacement for radixkv's and modelengine's pure-LRU victim choice behind FAK_NATIVE_KV_* flags.
rows.distinction: It is the CONCRETE victim-index picker scored by the base KVEvictionCost, distinct from KVEvictCostAware (the policy-enum label selecting this behavior inside the replay simulator, not a picker itself) and from radixkv's live evictToBudget LRU pass it is meant to eventually replace but has not yet been wired into.
